RECORDED RETROACTIVELY, and that is the first thing this instance says about itself. The run happened 2026-10-02 21:55Z-23:35Z with NO instance on disk: the steward rebuilt the train by hand, as every train before it had been. That is bean `vlhk`'s defect -- a STRICT rule whose breach looks exactly like compliance -- and it is why `hfag` carried 'train runs recorded as workflow instances' as an open box. Backfilled from git log and the GitHub API; EVERY entry below is re-derivable from those two sources, and none is reconstructed from memory of intent. Where this record is thinner than a live one would be, it says so rather than filling the gap.

WHY THIS TRAIN EXISTED: PR #1924 claimed eight members in its body while its pushed head 203c2732 carried only #1913 and #1903. The previous steward's six other merges existed only in a container that stopped. Verified with `git merge-base --is-ancestor <member> 203c2732` per member, not read off the body.

FIVE OF EIGHT MEMBERS WERE RED AT THEIR OWN HEADS AND THE TRAIN LANDED GREEN. That is this process's premise made visible: the reds were generated-file staleness, which the train's single regenerate repairs, and two were `cleanup` alone. A per-member gate would have refused five admissible PRs. It is also why T2 attributes a red train from member CI FIRST -- here that attribution would have pointed at four members at once, which is itself the signal that the cause is shared and generated.

The train went red twice, and neither cause was a member's change.

(1) `check:bean-parents` -- bean `krk0`, created by this very run, had no parent. Parented to epic `1xhc`.
(2) `check:ready-to-close` -- bean `tlk2` was tagged `ready-to-close` and reported as having NO evidence. It had evidence; the heading read `## Evidence (2026-10-02 21:36-21:40 UTC)` and the matcher is /^#{2,6}[ \t]+Evidence[ \t]*$/. The timestamp moved to the line below. No evidence was added, removed or reworded -- only the verdict was false.

No bisect was needed and no member was ejected: attribution reached the cause directly both times. `Task_Bisect`, `Task_Eject`, `Call_EjectHandBack` and `Task_RetryFlaky` were never reached, and this instance holds no token at any of them.

The evidence above therefore sits in `history[].note` as prose, which is the existing store and schema this box asked for, but it is NOT machine-readable and no gate can check it.
